description: §6.13.6 (S478; code name confirmed S479) — a write to a `debounced=` cell whose right-hand side reads the same cell is the lint W-TIMED-READ-MODIFY-WRITE (Warning): increments made inside one window are lost.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — open owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 32 · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 2 (code name confirmed)
rationale: §6.13.6: "A write to a `debounced=` / `throttled=` cell whose right-hand side reads the SAME cell … SHALL produce the lint **`W-TIMED-READ-MODIFY-WRITE`** (Warning) at the write."
